services.desc: At PHI MRO Services, we pride ourselves on our exceptional customer service and our ability to understand and meet the individual needs of all our customers when selecting the perfect lease helicopter. Whether you need an aircraft for business or personal use, our team will find the right solution for you. We make our process as simple and smooth as possible, using our deep familiarity with the industry and our vast network of resources to guide our customers through the complexities of aircraft leasing. blurb: PHI Aviation operates a fleet of over 200 helicopters including light, medium, and heavy-class aircraft from Bell, Leonardo, Sikorsky, and Airbus. They provide helicopter transportation services globally, supporting energy providers, hospitals, air medical organizations, government, and military. Their operations cover North America, Latin America, Africa, Australia, New Zealand, Southeast Asia, and the Eastern Mediterranean.
